name: MIRAIWERK ticket-intelligence benchmark
description: Hand-labelled commerce-platform tickets used to check classification, policy priority, recommendation and duplicate-candidate behaviour. Labels describe intended product behaviour, not a model's output.

plan.name: Commerce Platform Relaunch
plan.goal: Launch a reliable checkout experience without duplicate charges or broken order state.
plan.description: Relaunch of a direct-to-consumer storefront covering authentication, product discovery, checkout, payment retries, order lifecycle and release observability. The payments release gate must pass before production launch work proceeds.

constraints.technology: React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, payment processor
constraints.nonNegotiables: No duplicate payment capture. Every release needs a rollback plan and named on-call owner.

contextTickets.title: Customers charged twice after checkout retry
contextTickets.description: Production incident: when the payment confirmation request times out, the client retries automatically after five seconds. Some customers receive two captures for one order.

contextTickets.title: Search filters reset when returning from a product page
contextTickets.description: Apply a category and price filter, open a product, then press Back. Filter chips disappear and results reset because state is not persisted in the URL.

contextTickets.title: Add saved payment methods for returning customers
contextTickets.description: Returning customers should be able to save a payment method and reuse it at checkout. No success metric or scope boundary has been agreed yet.

contextTickets.title: Finance invoice export duplicates a charge line after plan upgrade
contextTickets.description: Finance reports that the monthly invoice CSV lists the same charge line twice after a plan upgrade with proration. The payment processor contains a single capture.

contextTickets.title: Checkout page slow on Safari
contextTickets.description: Checkout takes over eight seconds to become interactive in Safari 17 on macOS. Chrome is fast. Performance traces point at a large synchronous script in the payment step.

cases.title: Customers charged twice after checkout retry
cases.description: Production incident: the payment confirmation request times out and the client retries automatically. Some customers receive two captures for one order. Fourteen duplicate captures are confirmed since 09:10 UTC and automatic retries are still enabled.
cases.reportedImpact: 14 customers charged twice; support has refunded 6. The payments release gate is this week, so exposure is still increasing.
cases.evidence: Transactions pi_8841 and pi_8842 share idempotency key idem_5521 and produced two capture.succeeded webhooks. Application logs show the retry does not reuse the original idempotency key.
cases.note: Exact retry-path duplicate of the context incident; strong operational evidence.

cases.title: Payment capture webhook delivered twice after gateway timeout
cases.description: Production alert: the processor delivered the same capture.succeeded webhook twice after a gateway timeout. Reconciliation currently records one capture, but the webhook consumer is not idempotent.
cases.reportedImpact: One confirmed duplicate webhook. Order state is correct today, but the consumer could create a second fulfilment if the payload differs.
cases.evidence: Webhook event evt_2291 was delivered at 10:02:11 and 10:02:19 with identical payload and event id. Consumer logs show both deliveries were processed.
cases.note: Related payment area but a distinct webhook-idempotency root cause.

cases.title: Checkout freezes when applying a gift card
cases.description: Production incident: applying a valid gift card locks the checkout submit button indefinitely. The failure began after this morning's release and affects a small but growing set of orders.
cases.reportedImpact: 38 checkout attempts abandoned in two hours. Support has received 11 customer messages.
cases.evidence: Request trace 7f3a shows the cart totals call never resolves after the gift-card validation call. Browser console reports an unhandled promise rejection in the totals store.
cases.note: Customer-blocking production regression on a release-gate path.

cases.title: Authentication sessions revoked for all users after deploy
cases.description: Production incident: a configuration change revoked every active session. Users are being asked to sign in again and some password-reset links now return an invalid-token error.
cases.reportedImpact: All active customers were signed out. Support volume is four times normal and checkout conversion has dropped.
cases.evidence: Session table was truncated by migration 204 at 08:14. Deploy log shows the migration ran twice; the rollback has not been applied.
cases.note: Wide-impact auth incident with a clear deploy correlation.

cases.title: Order confirmation emails missing after successful payment
cases.description: Production issue: successful payments are not triggering order confirmation emails for some customers. The payment view shows paid, but the email provider has no send event.
cases.reportedImpact: Roughly 6% of paid orders today have no confirmation email. Support is manually resending messages.
cases.evidence: Provider dashboard shows zero send attempts for order ORD-8122. Worker logs show the email job was acknowledged but never enqueued after the queue migration.
cases.note: High-severity production incident with measurable impact and evidence.

cases.title: Payment success rate dropped in production
cases.description: Production monitoring shows the payment success rate dropped from 98.1% to 91.4% after the latest gateway configuration change. Failures cluster on one card network.
cases.reportedImpact: About 240 failed payment attempts in 90 minutes. The cause is not yet confirmed.
cases.evidence: Dashboard panel PAY-03 shows the drop at 13:05. Request traces for 20 failures all return processor code 402 with the same new routing profile.
cases.note: Medium-severity incident remains P1 under the documented policy.

cases.title: Authentication token refresh loops after session expiry
cases.description: Production incident: expired sessions enter a token-refresh loop. The browser repeatedly calls the refresh endpoint and protected pages never render.
cases.reportedImpact: At least 80 customers cannot reach account or checkout pages until they clear cookies.
cases.evidence: HAR capture shows 37 refresh calls in 20 seconds. Server logs return 401 for every call because the refresh token is rotated before the client stores it.
cases.note: Auth incident with reproduction evidence and customer impact.

cases.title: Catalog pages return 500 after CDN configuration change
cases.description: Production outage: category and product-detail pages return HTTP 500 for all visitors after a CDN routing change. The origin health check still reports green.
cases.reportedImpact: Site-wide discovery is unavailable. Checkout links are unreachable from category pages.
cases.evidence: CDN logs show 5,412 500 responses in eight minutes. Origin logs receive no requests, which points at edge routing rather than application code.
cases.note: Availability incident with evidence and a clear blast radius.

cases.title: Customers charged twice but no logs or transaction references
cases.description: Production incident: customers say they were charged twice after retrying checkout. No one has supplied a transaction id, screenshot, timestamp, or reproduction steps yet.
cases.note: Incident-shaped and likely the known retry issue, but the report is unusable as evidence: ask for a transaction reference before changing scope.

cases.title: Checkout errors increased this morning
cases.description: Production reports suggest checkout errors increased this morning after a configuration change. The team has not established the error rate, affected customers, or whether payments succeeded.
cases.evidence: Several reports in the on-call channel.
cases.note: Impact and rate are unknown, so P0 evidence requirements fail.

cases.title: Search filters reset when returning from a product page
cases.description: Apply a category and price filter, open a product, then press Back. The filter chips disappear and the result list resets. Expected filters to persist in the URL. This is a regression from last week's release.
cases.reportedImpact: Customers lose their filtered result set and must repeat the search. About one in five sessions uses filters.
cases.evidence: Reproduced four times in Chrome and Safari. URL query parameters are absent after back navigation; a session recording shows a full reload.
cases.note: Exact duplicate of the known search-filter regression.

cases.title: Filter chips lose state when navigating back
cases.description: After applying search filters and opening a product, navigating back clears every filter chip. This is a regression in the browser history handling.
cases.reportedImpact: Shoppers have to rebuild filters, which adds friction to repeat searches.
cases.evidence: Reproduced on Safari and Chrome. The URL loses the query string after back navigation.
cases.note: Near-duplicate wording of BUG-01; should link to the existing ticket.

cases.title: Cart totals wrong after applying a promo code
cases.description: When a percentage promo code is applied at checkout, the displayed total is calculated before the discount. The order is charged the undiscounted amount.
cases.reportedImpact: Customers are overcharged by the discount amount. Three orders are affected so far.
cases.evidence: Order ORD-6612 was charged 84.00 instead of 71.40. Server log shows the discount was persisted after the payment intent was created.
cases.note: Money-affecting checkout bug.

cases.title: Product images fail on category pages
cases.description: Category pages show broken image placeholders for every product. The image URLs return 404 after the asset migration.
cases.reportedImpact: Browsing looks broken and customers cannot compare products visually.
cases.evidence: Network panel shows 404 for 48 image requests under /assets/catalog/v2/. The product-detail page still uses the old path.
cases.note: Contained visual regression without payment risk.

cases.title: Order history shows stale delivery status
cases.description: The order history page shows 'processing' for deliveries that were completed days ago. The detail page shows the correct status.
cases.reportedImpact: Customers open support tickets asking where their order is. Support cannot explain the mismatch.
cases.evidence: Order ORD-7710 shows processing in history and delivered on the detail page. History is served from a cache with no invalidation after status changes.
cases.note: Correctness bug with limited financial exposure.

cases.title: Password reset link expires before it can be used
cases.description: Customers cannot complete a password reset because the emailed link expires as soon as it is opened. The error says the token is invalid.
cases.reportedImpact: Locked-out customers cannot recover access without contacting support.
cases.evidence: Reproduced with two accounts: the link works once in a private window but fails after the email client prefetches it. Server log shows the token consumed by the prefetch.
cases.note: Access-recovery bug; auth component is not in the configured escalation list.

cases.title: Mobile menu overlaps the cart icon
cases.description: On narrow viewports the navigation menu overlays the cart icon, so the cart cannot be tapped. This is a layout error introduced by the new header.
cases.reportedImpact: Mobile shoppers cannot reach the cart from the header.
cases.evidence: Reproduced at 375px and 390px widths in Chrome. The menu has a higher z-index and a full-width overlay.
cases.note: Small layout defect with a clear reproduction.

cases.title: Checkout crashes with more than 50 cart items
cases.description: Submitting a cart with more than 50 line items crashes the checkout page. The cart remains because the crash happens before the payment intent is created.
cases.reportedImpact: Wholesale buyers with large carts cannot complete an order.
cases.evidence: Reproduced with 51, 60 and 100 items. Console shows a maximum call stack error in the totals reducer; no payment request is sent.
cases.note: Checkout path failure with a reproducible boundary.

cases.title: Finance invoice export lists the same charge line twice
cases.description: The monthly invoice CSV contains the same charge line twice after a plan upgrade with proration. The duplicate line is an export bug, not a second capture.
cases.reportedImpact: Finance manually corrects invoices before month-end. No customer was charged twice by the processor.
cases.evidence: Two invoice CSV rows share invoice_id INV-2031 and line_item_id li_908. The processor export contains one capture for the period and no duplicate capture webhook.
cases.note: Duplicate of the finance invoice-export context ticket, not a payment incident.

cases.title: Saved payment method cannot be selected at checkout
cases.description: A saved card appears in the checkout list but cannot be selected. Choosing it returns a validation error and the customer must enter the card again.
cases.reportedImpact: Returning customers abandon checkout rather than re-entering card details.
cases.evidence: Reproduced with two saved methods. The selection request returns 422 because the saved-method id is sent in the wrong field.
cases.note: Same feature area as the saved-payment-methods request, but a distinct defect.

cases.title: Add saved payment methods for returning customers
cases.description: Returning customers should be able to save a payment method and reuse it at checkout. The request comes from customer success after repeated buyer feedback. No success metric or scope boundary has been agreed.
cases.reportedImpact: Repeat buyers re-enter payment details every time. Conversion impact is not measured.
cases.evidence: Eight customer interview notes mention saved payment methods; no funnel metric is attached.
cases.note: Exact duplicate of the context feature request; checkout component raises priority floor.

cases.title: Add a wishlist for saved products
cases.description: Customers would like to save products to a wishlist and return to them later. No target segment or success metric has been defined.
cases.reportedImpact: Repeat visitors lose products they were considering.
cases.evidence: Five customer interviews mention a wishlist. No usage data is attached.
cases.note: Unscoped feature request, not tied to a release gate.

cases.title: Add dark mode to the storefront
cases.description: Customers have asked for a dark theme across the storefront and account pages. There is no accessibility audit, design spec, or launch commitment.
cases.reportedImpact: Frequent night-time shoppers report eye strain. No metric is available.
cases.evidence: Two support conversations and one community post request dark mode.
cases.note: Low-urgency polish; defer behind active release work.

cases.title: Allow customers to schedule delivery windows
cases.description: Customers want to choose a two-hour delivery window during checkout. Fulfilment capacity, carrier integration, and pricing rules are all unresolved.
cases.reportedImpact: Missed deliveries generate support contacts, but the rate is not measured.
cases.evidence: Support tagged 23 conversations about missed delivery in the last month.
cases.note: Cross-team feature with unresolved dependencies; checkout is an escalation component, so the policy floor is P1.

cases.title: Support Apple Pay at checkout
cases.description: Customers should be able to pay with Apple Pay on supported devices. The payment processor supports the method, but the product and refund flows are not designed.
cases.reportedImpact: Mobile buyers abandon when they cannot use their preferred wallet.
cases.evidence: Processor capability is documented; no funnel data for Apple Pay demand is attached.
cases.note: Checkout feature request gets the P1 escalation floor but is not accepted on evidence.

cases.title: Add a multilingual checkout flow
cases.description: The checkout should support Spanish and French. Translation ownership, locale detection, and legal review are not yet planned.
cases.reportedImpact: Non-English buyers may abandon, but the drop-off is not quantified.
cases.evidence: Three customer emails request Spanish checkout. No analytics segmentation is attached.
cases.note: Not a duplicate of the saved-method request despite shared checkout language.

cases.title: Add loyalty points for repeat purchases
cases.description: Customers should earn points on completed orders and redeem them for discounts. Finance has not approved a liability model.
cases.reportedImpact: Repeat-purchase incentives are missing, but no baseline retention metric is supplied.
cases.evidence: Two merchant planning notes mention loyalty. No customer research is attached.
cases.note: Requires finance and product definition before scheduling.

cases.title: Add gift card redemption at checkout
cases.description: Customers should be able to redeem a gift card during checkout. The current gift-card apply path freezes, and redemption rules are not yet agreed.
cases.reportedImpact: Gift-card buyers cannot complete a purchase with their balance.
cases.evidence: The apply endpoint exists behind a disabled flag. No redemption policy or accounting treatment is documented.
cases.note: Feature request, not the existing gift-card freeze incident.

cases.title: Upgrade React 18 to React 19
cases.description: The storefront is two major versions behind. The upgrade is a scheduled technical-debt task with no customer-facing defect.
cases.reportedImpact: No active customer impact. Blocked dependency upgrades accumulate.
cases.evidence: Dependency audit lists three packages that require React 19.
cases.note: Planned platform maintenance, defer behind release work.

cases.title: Remove deprecated billing SDK
cases.description: The old billing SDK is deprecated and still imported by two jobs. This is a cleanup task; no customer defect has been reported.
cases.reportedImpact: No active impact. The deprecated library will stop receiving security patches.
cases.evidence: Dependency report shows the package is end-of-life; both imports are listed.
cases.note: Security debt should be scheduled explicitly, not silently accepted.

cases.title: Refactor the order state machine
cases.description: The order state machine has grown into a single switch statement. The team wants a refactor to reduce regression risk; no current defect is reported.
cases.reportedImpact: Maintenance cost is increasing, but no customer-facing failure is active.
cases.evidence: The module is 1,900 lines with 42 states and no unit tests.
cases.note: Refactor without a release-gate blocker.

cases.title: Stabilize the flaky integration test suite
cases.description: The integration suite is flaky and blocks unrelated pull requests. The team wants to remove the flakiness before the next release gate.
cases.reportedImpact: Roughly one in four CI runs fails for unrelated reasons, slowing delivery.
cases.evidence: CI history shows 24 failures in 100 runs across three test files. The failures all retry successfully.
cases.note: Delivery-quality debt, not a customer incident.

cases.title: Something about checkout seems off on some devices
cases.description: The checkout experience seems off on some devices. We do not have a reproducible example, logs, affected-user details, or a clear expected outcome yet.
cases.note: Vague but touches checkout, so the policy floor is P1; no plan change.

cases.title: App performance changed in the last release
cases.description: The team has noticed the app feels different since the last release. There is no reproduction, metric, environment, or expected outcome yet.
cases.note: No measurable signal; ask for a metric before planning work.

cases.title: Customer feedback about checkout experience
cases.description: A customer shared feedback about checkout. The note does not describe a defect, expected behaviour, device, or affected order.
cases.note: Checkout keyword raises priority, but the ticket is not actionable.

cases.title: Question about invoice numbering
cases.description: Finance asked whether invoice numbers should reset each year. No defect, impacted user, or expected change has been identified.
cases.note: A question is not a work item until the desired outcome is defined.

cases.title: Possible concern about performance in the EU region
cases.description: A partner mentioned that performance might be different in the EU region. No metric, screenshot, or user report is attached.
cases.note: Speculative signal; do not invent a capacity or latency commitment.

cases.title: Need to discuss the Q1 roadmap
cases.description: A stakeholder wants to discuss Q1 priorities. The ticket contains no product behaviour, defect, or acceptance criteria.
cases.note: Planning conversation, not ticket-level work.

cases.title: Unclear feedback about cart behaviour
cases.description: Support forwarded a short note about cart behaviour. The note has no steps, expected result, or affected customer.
cases.note: Ask for a concrete reproduction instead of guessing a fix.

cases.title: Note from customers about checkout
cases.description: Several customers left a short note about checkout. The note has no details, expected outcome, or order reference.
cases.note: Checkout escalation floor applies even when the report is unusable.
